Modality.description:
Which kind of video this run produces. Shared across IdeaRequestV1,
MasterVideoV1, and DisclosureDecisionV1 — import this rather than
redefining modality as a plain string elsewhere.
Modality.title: Modality

description:
The starting input for a run - what the person asked for.

identity_id is required only when modality is AVATAR (faceless runs
have no avatar identity). voice_id is required for both modalities,
since faceless runs still have narration.

idea_request_id.description: Unique ID for this idea request
idea_request_id.title: Idea Request Id

modality.description: Which kind of video this run produces

topic.description: What the video should be about
topic.title: Topic

identity_id.description: Which IdentityProfileV1 to use. Required when modality=AVATAR; must be omitted/None for FACELESS runs.
identity_id.title: Identity Id

style_id.description: Which StyleProfileV1 to use, if one was chosen
style_id.title: Style Id

consent_grant_id.description: Which ConsentGrantV1 covers this request's identity/voice. Optional for now - whether this should be mandatory before a run is allowed to proceed is a pending team decision, not yet enforced here.
consent_grant_id.title: Consent Grant Id

requested_by.description: Who requested this video, if known
requested_by.title: Requested By

metadata.description: Non-schema contextual data, mirroring StageOutputV1's metadata field - an intentional escape hatch for fields we haven't formalized yet.
metadata.title: Metadata
